description: This file contains the implementation of the ShoppingCartFacade, specifically the class 'ShoppingCartFacadeImpl' which manages shopping cart operations such as adding, updating, deleting items, and retrieving shopping cart data in an e-commerce application.

classes.name: ShoppingCartFacadeImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ShoppingCartFacade interface managing shopping cart operations such as adding, updating, deleting items, and retrieving shopping cart data.

methods.name: deleteShoppingCart
methods.description: Deletes a shopping cart by its ID or code, associated with a MerchantStore.

methods.name: addItemsToShoppingCart
methods.description: Adds an item to the shopping cart and updates cart details accordingly.

methods.name: createCartModel
methods.description: Creates a new ShoppingCart model object with a specified code, store, and customer context.

methods.name: getShoppingCartData
methods.description: Retrieves shopping cart data for a customer or by cart code, populating it with details.

methods.name: removeCartItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart based on its ID, returning the updated cart data.

methods.name: updateCartItem
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific cart item identified by its ID.

methods.name: updateCartItems
methods.description: Updates multiple cart items at once with new quantities.

methods.name: getCartModel
methods.description: Fetches a ShoppingCart model object by its cart code.
